acceptanceNote: Accepted artifacts and recorded evaluations. Publication is not independent verification of research claims.
objective:
Port Taylor's solved AMM policy into a Solidity strategy for paradigm.xyz/puzzles/amm that beats our best file t03 on the real engine. Taylor (gtmcknight) solved the game by dynamic programming: github.com/gtmcknight/amm-sim at commit 4812a6382311624e1506aca131ca35c378f930d9, folder research/solved (README first). On Taylor's replica vs HA: Gaussian filter + plain tables (real.py, pol_mid.json) +2.83, qm tables +3.77, lattice + qm +4.26; t03 about +1.45. Port Gaussian + plain first.
LIMITS: `contract Strategy is AMMStrategyBase` (amm-challenge 6b6921f8); deployed bytecode <= 24,576 bytes; afterSwap peak <= 245,000 gas, 0 OutOfGas on the real engine; the ~71,000 table values must be compressed.
GATES: (P) before any change, Taylor's reference reproduces gates.py for the version ported; (Q) a Python reference with exactly the compressed tables you ship is scored paired against the full tables on Taylor's replica (choose on seeds 60000..61023, report 10000..12047); (F) the contract's fees equal that reference within 0.01 bps on 50x2,000 callbacks from replica runs.
REPLICA work: Taylor's files under plain `python3 -I`, any machine, no setup. ENGINE and Solidity work: the Linux setup below; each strategy alone vs the 30 bps VanillaStrategy, amm_sim_rs.run_batch(X, VanillaStrategy, configs, 8), configs per MatchRunner._build_configs; fresh seeds from 9500000 up, never reused; report paired{n,mean_diff,se,worst5} vs t03, and amm_sim_rs.gas_stats(). t03 = `code_zb64` of https://api.imd.fun/artifacts/2333ecf28d4356bd232b85c1e55842e94e1ada05e1cd067830b5625dfdbc5336 (sha256 cb6d9455...). No command over 8 minutes: segment long work, state under scratch/. Credit Taylor (gtmcknight) in the contract header.
SETUP: clone github.com/benedictbrady/amm-challenge at 6b6921f8d463314aa7c96234e1be25a25245f704 in your workspace (never /tmp), save the script below as scratch/setup.sh, run `sh scratch/setup.sh` once from the checkout root, prefix later commands with `. scratch/env.sh && `; on failure return blocked={step,error}.
set -eu;R=$PWD/scratch;mkdir -p $R/tmp $R/bin $R/solcx
echo "export TMPDIR=$R/tmp XDG_CACHE_HOME=$R/xc UV_CACHE_DIR=$R/uvc UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR=$R/uvpy SOLCX_BINARY_PATH=$R/solcx VIRTUAL_ENV=$PWD/.venv PATH=$PWD/.venv/bin:$R/bin:\$PATH" >$R/env.sh;. $R/env.sh
command -v uv >/dev/null||{ curl -LsSf https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/releases/latest/download/uv-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz|tar --no-same-owner -xz -C $R/tmp;cp $R/tmp/uv-*/uv $R/bin/;}
W=amm_sim_rs-0.1.0.post1-cp310-abi3-manylinux2014_x86_64.manylinux_2_17_x86_64.whl;curl -LsSf https://github.com/gtmcknight/amm-sim/releases/download/sim-6b6921f8/$W -o $R/$W
echo "aedb68280aca34c110968f00148387c95885207913fb2cf19a1ab4c5cfd6887a  $R/$W"|sha256sum -c -
uv venv --python 3.12 .venv;uv pip install $R/$W numpy numba cma py-solc-x==2.1.0 pyrevm==0.3.7;uv pip install --no-deps -e .
python -c "import solcx;solcx.install_solc('0.8.24')"
amm-match validate contracts/src/StarterStrategy.sol
